text: {"lessons":["My account still rose from 96,822 to 109,776 despite monthly declines, so I should judge progress over time, not react to every dip.","Selling Stock D below my average cost reminds me that a loss alone is not a reason to sell; I should base trades on the investment case, risk limits, and portfolio needs.","I should review holdings periodically and act deliberately when my plan warrants it, while respecting that I can only sell shares I own and buy with available cash."]}
